name: factoria
description: Debug the JavaScript of a FactorIA game: breakpoints, stepping, variables and the debug console, from F5.

mode.description: What to run. play: the game in its window, like `factoria run`. headless: a fixed number of frames without a window, optionally replaying an input file, like `factoria run --headless`. test: the project's tests/*.test.js, like `factoria test`.

project.description: The project folder (the one with factoria.json).

scene.description: play, headless: the scene to start in (default: the project's main scene).

frames.description: headless: how many frames to run.

input.description: headless: an input replay file to play back.

tests.description: test: the test files to run (default: every tests/*.test.js).

filter.description: test: only run tests whose name contains this text.

stopOnEntry.description: Stop at the first statement of the first script that runs.

factoriaPath.description: The factoria executable to start as the debug adapter (`factoria dap`). Default: the one `factoria setup vscode` recorded when it installed this extension, else `factoria` on the PATH.

configurationSnippets.label: FactorIA: Play
configurationSnippets.description: Run the game in its window and debug its scripts.

configurationSnippets.label: FactorIA: Headless
configurationSnippets.description: Run the game for a number of frames without a window and debug its scripts.

configurationSnippets.label: FactorIA: Tests
configurationSnippets.description: Run the project's tests/*.test.js and debug them.
